pages.text:
Stand on a Chargepad to charge your FE items: the one in your hand, everything in your hotbar, and anything you wear, such as Arc Drills, Arc Saws and Batteries.
- Feed it FE through the energy port on the back of its housing: a conduit connects there, and only there.
- It holds 500,000 FE and charges each item at up to 2,048 FE/t, 8,192 FE/t in total.
- The gauge on the housing shows how full it is, and the coil glows while it's charging something.
